newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea raises some int'l air fares by three pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea raises some int'l air fares by three pct.

text.p: South Korea will raise the fares for some international flights from Seoul by an average three percent from January 1, the Ministry of Construction and Transportation said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that the fares of flights to Europe, Asia and the Middle East would be raised. The increase would not affect flights to North America, China, Japan and Australasia.
The changes were in line the International Air Transport Association's decision last month to raise air fares due to rising jet fuel prices, it said.
